title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines
abstract: arXiv:2611.30819v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether. Across 60,000 responses, we find that answers to the same prompt name a different first item 32% of the time, and even two answers with the same items disagree on which comes first. The first position is a measurement target of its own. A "clear leader" emerges after seven or eight runs, which are the budgets recommended for brand and source monitoring, but a "close leader" only about half the time. After 25 runs, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time. Variability between engines is larger than within the same engine. translated_title: 再次询问：生成式引擎中答案列表的不稳定性
translated_abstract: 生成式搜索引擎中的可见性是通过哪些实体出现在回答中、以及以什么顺序出现来衡量的。向引擎询问同一个问题两次，答案列表就可能发生变化：排序不同，或者条目完全不同。通过对60,000条回答的分析，我们发现对同一个提示，答案有32%的概率给出不同的第一项；即使两个答案包含完全相同的条目，它们对哪个条目排在第一位的判断也不一致。第一名本身就是一个独立的测量目标。在运行七到八次之后，才会出现一个“明显的领先者”——而这正是品牌与来源监控所推荐的测量次数预算——但“接近的领先者”只在一半左右的情况下出现。即使运行25次，接近的领先者也只有在60%的情况下能被识别出来。引擎之间的变异性大于同一引擎内部的变异性。对于开放式提示，其差距是确定性提示的两倍以上。观察到的搜索查询和引用网站只能解释其中一小部分分歧，大部分分歧仍然无法解释。可见性可测
tldr: 该研究通过对6万条生成式引擎回答的大规模测量，首次系统揭示了生成式搜索引擎答案列表的不稳定性——同一问题的答案有32%的概率给出不同的第一名，即便重复25次也只有60%的概率能确定接近的领先者，且引擎间差异大于引擎内部、开放式问题的不稳定性是确定性问题的两倍以上，因此对生成式引擎可见性的可靠监测远比现有推荐的方法更困难。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale measurement of 60,000 generative engine responses, this study systematically reveals answer-list instability in generative search engines—the same prompt yields a different first item 32% of the time, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time even after 25 runs, between-engine variability exceeds within-engine variability, and open-ended prompts show more than double the instability of determinate ones—implying that reliable visibility monitoring in generative engines is far harder than currently recommended practices assume.
